dialog.title: Export code
dialog.description: Your database schema as a framework's files: models, migrations or scripts, for the version you use.
dialog.emptyDescription: Add database tables to the board, then export them as code.

overwrite.title: Replace existing files?
overwrite.description_one: {count} file is already in this folder and will be replaced.
overwrite.description_other: {count} files are already in this folder and will be replaced.

warnings.missing-table: {table} isn't exported: its foreign keys are kept, but no relation is written to it.
warnings.unknown-type: {table}.{column}: the type {type} has no equivalent in {target}, so {fallback} is used.
warnings.reserved-word: {name} is a reserved word in {target}; rename it to avoid errors.
warnings.name-collision: {names} all become {converted}; the later ones get a number.
warnings.composite-key: {table} has a composite primary key, which {target} models can't express.
warnings.fk-cycle: {table}.{column} closes a cycle of foreign keys, so it's added after every table.
warnings.many-to-many: {from} and {to} are many to many: add a pivot table to the schema to export it.
warnings.unsupported-default: {table}.{column}: the default {value} can't be written in {target}.
warnings.unsupported-reference: {table}.{column}: {target} has no foreign keys, so it's a plain field.
warnings.unsupported-index: {table}: an index on an expression can't be written in {target}.
warnings.unsupported-index-method: {table}: {target} has no {method} indexes, so the default is used.
